fields.summary: fcrepo-webapp-plus-webac-4.6.0.war doesn't seem to work in jetty

comments.body: Once this works in Jetty, we should also update the fcrepo-import-export project to use jetty in the integration tests.
Andrew Woods: This problem does not occur in 4.8.0-SNAPSHOT. Do we really need to fix this in 4.6.x? Or shall I punt on this one?

Danny Bernstein, If this is only a 4.6.x issue and has been resolved in the "master" and "4.7.1-RC" branches, then we can close this issue as "Fixed".
How did you test the issue?

P.S. As noted, a follow-on ticket should also be created to update the fcrepo-import-export project to use jetty in the integration tests.

Basically I confirmed the problem in 4.6.0. Then I pulled the latest code from master and ran
MAVEN_OPTS="-Dfcrepo.modeshape.configuration=classpath:/config/file-simple/repository.json" ; mvn jetty:run -P webac

The errors that Mike mentioned disappeared.
Michael Durbin, please close this ticket if the resolution addresses your issue.
I verified this works with the jetty-maven-plugin vesion 9.4.0.M1.
